manifest.yaml.title: Kurdish COIN 1984-1999

hotPursuit.description: Early KDP hot pursuit exception, C1 and C2, at most 3 Troops (06 s3.2; Low evidence)

syriaMarchRestricted.description: PA-16 (GAP-I02). allow: PKK March into Syria-Bekaa at Restricted, +1 Resource, group Activates (06 s4.2). deny: Host or Tolerant only (03 s3)

assumptions.yaml.text: The executing faction makes every choice that the card does not assign
Diplomacy moves a posture one step along Host, Tolerant, Restricted, Hostile, Aligned. Hostile to Aligned needs modified 6 or more. Syria at Hostile is no effect
Use the modified die total as is. No automatic success or failure on a natural roll
A track or posture change that passes an end stops at the end. The excess is lost. Legitimacy keeps its own overflow rule
Coerce resolves its shift before it places a marker. A Coercion marker already present blocks the shift. Activation still happens

In an Ambush space the Attack has no roll: Activate only 1 Underground Guerrilla, remove 1 State piece in the Attack order, no attrition and no bonus Guerrilla (06 s5.1; designer decision after the S0 playtests)
Count pieces in the space after the movement step when activating
Assault removals above the removable pieces are lost
If no marker of the type is available, the placement does not happen and the log records supply exhausted. Harm markers also raise a warning
Equal margins at a victory check: lower Harm count wins, then PKK
Any no vote on Talks ends the ceasefire. Ceasefire goes to None
The PKK chooses any subset of qualifying Extort locations. Each activates one Guerrilla and gives +1 Resource
All random selections use the session seeded generator
Air Mobility never uses an external box as origin or destination. Troops leave a box only at Redeploy
The executing faction chooses any 2 Offices to remove. Legitimacy -1
PKK March into Syria-Bekaa is allowed at Restricted with +1 Resource; the group Activates. Package option syriaMarchRestricted
Scenario A Pivotals: PKK ARGK Formed only. The State has none
